description: Voice-native flight recorder and recall system for EMS crews: captures the decisions medics make and the reasons they give, embeds them in MongoDB Atlas, and retrieves that reasoning to brief the next crew.

executionModel.note: PHASE-01 is the only prerequisite for phases 02-15, which run in parallel. PHASE-16 is serial after that wave: it flips every port from fake to real and runs the end-to-end smoke.
rules: Own only the files listed in your phase's `owns` array. Never create or edit a file owned by another phase.
Import only from @/lib/contracts, @/lib/ports, @/lib/registry, @/lib/db/client, and your own files.
Set the *_MODE env vars of ports you consume to `fake` so your phase verifies with zero dependency on other phases.
A shared type that is not in .ralph/contracts.md is a contract change: update contracts.md and agents.md before implementing it.

phases.title: NYC Dispatch Ingestion and the Pitch Number
LangGraph, MongoDB Checkpointer, and the Readback Interrupt
Decision Capture, Postmortem Generator, ePCR Draft
Tool, Demo, and State API Routes

tasks.title: Next.js scaffold, env validation, and Mongo client
acceptanceCriteria: npm install completes with the versions pinned in overview.md
npm run build succeeds and npm run dev serves a page without runtime error
package.json contains every script listed in contracts.md section 12
next.config.ts lists mongodb, unpdf, and @langchain/langgraph-checkpoint-mongodb in serverExternalPackages
assertEmbeddingConfig() throws on a deliberate EMBEDDING_MODEL / EMBEDDING_DIM mismatch
The Mongo client is cached on globalThis so 6 consecutive dev hot-reloads do not exhaust the Atlas connection pool
npm run check exits 0 against the live cluster and non-zero with a corrupted MONGODB_URI
Cluster tier is confirmed Flex or higher, or the M0 Plan B deviation is recorded in contracts.md and agents.md

tasks.title: Transcribe contracts.md into src/lib/contracts, ports.ts, and registry.ts
acceptanceCriteria: Every type, interface, and constant in contracts.md sections 2 through 10 exists and is exported from @/lib/contracts or @/lib/ports
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors under strict mode
labelFor() never returns a bare dispatch code for any key in CODE_LABELS or for an unknown code
toDisplayId() returns a 4-digit left-padded string for an 8-digit incident id
registry.ts resolves fakes when the matching *_MODE is `fake`
registry.ts falls back to the fake and logs a warning containing the string FAKE PORT when a real module is absent
registry.ts uses only static string literals in its dynamic imports so no phase ever needs to edit it

tasks.title: Deterministic fakes for all six ports plus fixtures
acceptanceCriteria: All seven fakes satisfy their port interfaces, verified by a type-level assignment
fakes/embeddings.embedOne returns env.embeddingDim floats and two calls on the same text return identical arrays
Two different strings produce vectors with cosine similarity below 0.5
fakes/retrieval.signatureMatch returns null for a query containing `transfer` and a populated match otherwise
All six owned fixture files exist and parse as their contract types

fixtures/event-stream.json contains every field needed to render reference.png, including incident ref 260813-0442, four voice turns, one decision, one awaiting readback, three retrieval hits at 0.91/0.87/0.84, and checkpoint count 34
fixtures/incidents.json includes _groundTruth on historical records so answer-stripping can be tested offline
No fake performs any network or database call

tasks.title: Create collections, JSON Schema validators, and standard indexes
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/create-indexes.ts creates all collections named in contracts.md section 2 on a clean database
Inserting a decisions document with rationale set to an empty string is rejected by the server-side validator
Inserting a decisions document with a valid non-empty rationale and actionChosen succeeds
incidents.incidentId has a unique index
events has a TTL index on t with expireAfterSeconds 86400
Running the script a second time creates nothing, errors on nothing, and exits 0
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Create four Atlas Vector Search indexes and block until READY
acceptanceCriteria: Four vector search indexes named vs_decisions, vs_remediations, vs_runbooks, vs_postmortems are created
Every index numDimensions equals env.embeddingDim, asserted and printed by the script

Declared filter paths exist on the target collection: callTypeFamily and outcome on decisions, callTypeFamily/outcome/origin on remediations, callTypeFamily/origin on postmortems, sectionTitle on runbooks
The script polls listSearchIndexes and does not exit until all four report status READY, printing progress
The script exits non-zero with an explicit message when the cluster tier cannot host four search indexes

tasks.title: Implement EmbeddingsPort with batching, retry, and Mongo-backed cache
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/embeddings/index.ts default-exports an object satisfying EmbeddingsPort
embedOne returns exactly env.embeddingDim floats
embed() on 300 short strings issues at most 3 provider requests, verified by a logged request counter
Input order is preserved: embed(['a','b','c'])[1] equals embedOne('b') for the same input type
Voyage calls pass input_type document for writes and query for searches; OpenAI accepts and ignores the parameter
A second identical call is served from the _embed_cache collection and the cache document count does not grow
Switching EMBEDDING_PROVIDER to openai with EMBEDDING_DIM 1536 works without changing any call site
A returned vector of the wrong length throws an error naming both the expected and actual dimension
A 400 response is not retried; a 429 is retried with backoff
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Ingest NYC dispatch slices with answers stripped
acceptanceCriteria: npm run ingest:incidents inserts between 100 and 250 historical documents
At least 20 documents match cad.initialCallType UNC with _groundTruth.finalCallType ARREST
At least 20 documents match cad.initialCallType SICK with _groundTruth.finalCallType CARD
No document has a top-level finalCallType, finalSeverityLevelCode, or incidentCloseDatetime
Every cad.initialSeverityLevelCode is an integer between 1 and 8
Every cad.incidentDatetime is a Date instance, not a string
Every document has displayId, ref, callTypeFamily, and isLive false
Every Socrata request sends $order=incident_id and a $limit no larger than the contracts.md section 14 constant for that slice
Query parameters are encoded by URLSearchParams rather than hand-built strings
The script never requests rows.csv or a $limit of 1000 or more
Re-running the script leaves the document count unchanged
Every ingested initialCallType resolves to a label via labelFor, and any miss is reported
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Compute the pitch number and reclassification priors from the data
acceptanceCriteria: npm run pitch prints total incidents, the 2023+ call-type-change rate, the all-time rate, the undertriage rate, and the reopen rate
The 2023+ call-type-change rate computes to approximately 15.0 percent
Results are written to data/pitch-numbers.json and read from cache on subsequent runs without a network call
Pitch numbers are computed only with Socrata count(1) and $group queries, never by downloading incident rows
data/reclass-priors.json is produced with ReclassPrior-shaped records; every pct is computed from a Socrata count, not a literal
A disagreement between a fresh computation and the values in overview.md is reported explicitly rather than silently overwritten

tasks.title: Download, chunk, embed, and load the NASEMSO guideline corpus
acceptanceCriteria: The PDF is downloaded from the ems.utah.gov mirror, not nasemso.org, and cached to data/
npm run ingest:runbooks prefers RUNBOOK_CHAPTER_FILTER chapters and writes between 30 and 400 documents to runbooks
Every document has non-empty text, sectionTitle, at least one sectionPath element, pageStart, embedding, and embeddedText
Every embedding has length env.embeddingDim
Mean text length is between 400 and 2000 characters
No chunk text contains a running header or footer line that appears on more than 20 percent of pages
Front matter and reference lists are excluded; the 2022 Field Triage appendix is included
Three randomly sampled chunks read as coherent prose that could be spoken aloud without sounding truncated
A chunk count below 50 or above 3000 aborts before any embedding call is made
Re-running replaces rather than duplicates and the count is stable
The phase verifies with EMBEDDINGS_MODE=fake
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Generate and load seeded postmortem narratives
acceptanceCriteria: npm run seed writes at least 30 postmortems with origin seeded (SEED_TARGET is 40)
At least 15 come from UNC to ARREST and at least 15 from SICK to CARD
Every narrative is between 40 and 200 words and has an embedding of length env.embeddingDim
Every postmortem has displayId, whatChanged, severityDelta, and callTypeFamily
No generated narrative contains a numeric drug dose, verified by grepping for mg, mcg, and mL and reviewing every hit
The --templated path is the default and produces a complete corpus with zero LLM calls
A fixed random seed makes two runs select the same incidents
The script asserts decisions.countDocuments() is 0 when it finishes and fails loudly otherwise
Re-running leaves seeded counts stable and does not delete curated or live documents
The phase verifies with EMBEDDINGS_MODE=fake and LLM_MODE=fake
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Derive remediations with real cost, plus curated demo postmortems
acceptanceCriteria: remediations contains both success and failure documents with at least 10 failures
reopenIndicator true, severityDelta above 0, and total time above 1.5x the family median each produce a failure
Every failure costMinutes is computed as (incidentTotalSeconds - familyMedianSeconds)/60 clamped at 0, never a hardcoded literal
Family medians are computed once with a single aggregation rather than per row
fixtures/curated-postmortems.json contains 2 or 3 records, each attached to a real ingested incidentId with real response-time values
Every curated record is marked origin curated and is distinguishable from seeded and live
At least one curated narrative contains the receiving-facility diversion detail and its derived cost in minutes

tasks.title: Single-pipeline three-collection fan-out with RRF fusion
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/retrieval/index.ts default-exports an object satisfying RetrievalPort
fanOut issues exactly one aggregate call, verified with driver command monitoring
The pipeline runs on decisions and reaches postmortems and runbooks through $unionWith sub-pipelines that each begin with $vectorSearch
vectorSearchScore is captured immediately after each $vectorSearch inside its own sub-pipeline
numCandidates is at least 20 times the limit for every sub-pipeline
Results include hits from postmortems and runbooks while decisions is empty, and no exception is thrown
Fusion uses reciprocal rank fusion with RRF_K and SOURCE_WEIGHTS from the contract, not raw cross-collection score comparison
Every Hit carries source, docId, rank, raw score, rrf, title, text, and a spoken field
Every spoken field is 40 words or fewer
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Signature match, failure memory, reclassification priors, and the verify script
acceptanceCriteria: signatureMatch searches decisions and postmortems only, never runbooks
signatureMatch returns null for an off-distribution query such as routine interfacility transfer, stable
signatureMatch returns a match with a displayId for a UNC to ARREST style query
Every signatureMatch summary is 25 words or fewer
failureMemory returns only remediations with outcome failure, plus postmortems with severityDelta above 0
reclassPrior reads data/reclass-priors.json, caches it, and returns null when the file is absent instead of throwing
npm run verify:retrieval prints every vs_* index status first and exits non-zero with a clear message if any is not READY
The script runs 4 fixed probe queries and asserts hits arrive from at least 2 distinct sources
--show-pipeline prints the aggregation pipeline
The phase verifies with EMBEDDINGS_MODE=fake

tasks.title: Graph state, MongoDBSaver checkpointer, and node wiring
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/graph/index.ts default-exports an object satisfying GraphPort
The graph compiles with MongoDBSaver using the shared client, checkpoint collection checkpoints and writes collection checkpoint_writes
grep across the repository returns zero occurrences of MemorySaver
thread_id equals incidentId for every invocation
timeline, nodeTrail, retrieved, and decisionsRecorded use concat reducers while other fields are last-write-wins
A full call produces a nodeTrail containing every node in graph order
checkpoints and checkpoint_writes are non-empty after one run
Every node emits a node event on enter and on exit
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Memory nodes: signature match, brief, and failure-excluding plan
acceptanceCriteria: triage performs no LLM call
brief output is 55 words or fewer
brief says new signature, no prior history when signature is null
brief never contains a raw dispatch code such as UNC or EDP
plan.excludedPaths is non-empty for a SICK-to-cardiac incident that has seeded failure memory
Every excludedPath carries a why, a sourceDisplayId, and a costMinutes value or null
plan logs a warning when excludedPaths is empty
No plan.steps entry matches the dose pattern /\d+\s*(mg|mcg|mL|g)\b/i, enforced by a filter and not only by the prompt
The phase verifies with RETRIEVAL_MODE=fake and LLM_MODE=fake

tasks.title: Readback and await_input interrupts with verified crash resume
acceptanceCriteria: A run reaches readback_gate and returns an interrupt payload of type readback
graph.getState(...).next reports the pending node while interrupted
Neither readback_gate nor await_input performs any write or emit before calling interrupt()
Killing the process while interrupted, starting a fresh process, and resuming with Command continues from the gate with timeline and signature intact
Decision and remediation counts after a kill-and-resume run are identical to an uninterrupted run, proving no duplicated side effects
npm run drill automates the kill-and-resume and exits 0 on success
npm run graph:local --auto-confirm completes a full call including postmortem

tasks.title: Decision writer with enforced rationale
acceptanceCriteria: recordDecision throws on an empty rationale before any database call is made
recordDecision throws on a whitespace-only rationale
A valid call inserts exactly one document whose embeddedText contains the rationale as a substring
embeddedText concatenates utterance, actionChosen, and rationale
The inserted embedding has length env.embeddingDim
A decision event is emitted through EventsPort on every successful write
The module contains no LLM call, since rationale extraction belongs to PHASE-13
The phase verifies with EMBEDDINGS_MODE=fake and EVENTS_MODE=fake
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Live postmortem generator and ePCR draft
acceptanceCriteria: generateAndWrite produces a postmortem with origin live, 40 to 200 words, and a valid embedding
The live narrative uses the same register and length band as the seeded corpus
whatChanged is derived from the observed call outcome and never from _groundTruth
A live postmortem is retrievable by fanOut immediately after being written
draftPcr returns all eight sections in medic-expected order
The Clinical rationale section is non-empty when the call recorded at least one decision
renderPcrText output begins with an unsigned-draft header and is never marked final
Neither the postmortem narrative nor the ePCR text contains any value read from _groundTruth
The full close path completes in under 8 seconds

tasks.title: MongoDB-backed event bus implementing EventsPort
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/events/index.ts default-exports an object satisfying EventsPort
emit assigns a monotonic seq per incident using an atomic counter rather than a document count
Concurrent emits produce no duplicate seq values for the same incident
recent(incidentId, n) returns the last n events in ascending seq order
Events are persisted to the events collection so any process can emit
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: SSE route streaming from an Atlas change stream
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/events sets Content-Type text/event-stream, Cache-Control no-cache no-transform, and X-Accel-Buffering no
The route exports runtime nodejs and dynamic force-dynamic
The first frame is a replay of the last 200 events for the requested incident
New events inserted by any process reach a connected client within 1 second
A heartbeat comment is sent at least every 15 seconds
The change stream cursor is closed when the client disconnects, verified by opening and closing 10 connections without growing the server's cursor count
A slow client is dropped rather than allowed to block the producer

tasks.title: Seven voice tool routes with validation and latency budgets
acceptanceCriteria: All seven tool routes exist at /api/tools/[tool] and validate their body with the Zod schema from the contract
Every tool route returns 401 without a matching X-BlackBox-Secret header
An invalid body returns 400 with an { error } shape
params is awaited, matching the Next.js 16 Promise signature
recall_memory and get_protocol return in under 400 ms warm, measured not assumed
propose_readback returns in under 300 ms, contains the drug, dose, and route verbatim, and makes no LLM call
record_decision returns in under 300 ms and the document appears within 3 seconds via a background write
confirm_readback resumes the interrupted graph and clears the pending interrupt
Every snippet returned to the voice agent has a spoken field of 40 words or fewer
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Demo control, state, and counter routes
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/demo/fire clones a real ingested incident matching the requested pattern into a fresh isLive document and returns incidentId, ref, and displayId
POST /api/demo/fire with pattern arrest selects a UNC to ARREST incident and with pattern cardiac a SICK to CARD incident
POST /api/demo/reset deletes all decisions, live postmortems, live remediations, all events, all checkpoints, and isLive incidents
POST /api/demo/reset leaves runbooks, seeded postmortems, and seeded remediations counts unchanged, asserted before and after
GET /api/state/[incidentId] returns values, next, and checkpointCount
GET /api/counters returns per-collection counts, checkpointCount, and embedding provider info
The phase verifies with GRAPH_MODE=fake

tasks.title: Change stream worker with resume token and polling fallback
acceptanceCriteria: npm run worker starts and logs the active trigger mode
Inserting an isLive incident starts a graph run with no polling loop active in changestream mode
A second watcher on decisions, postmortems, and remediations emits write events
The resume token is persisted to _watch_state after each event and passed as resumeAfter on startup
An incident inserted while the worker is stopped is processed after restart, proving the resume token works
TRIGGER_MODE=poll fires the graph within 3 seconds of an insert
A missing collection produces a clear error message instead of hanging
SIGINT closes both cursors and exits cleanly
The phase verifies with GRAPH_MODE=fake
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: ElevenLabs agent configuration and system prompt
acceptanceCriteria: The current agent-create payload shape and server-tool schema format were confirmed against live ElevenLabs documentation before the config was written
npm run agent:setup creates or updates an agent and prints an agentId, and is idempotent across runs
All seven server tools are registered and point at PUBLIC_BASE_URL/api/tools/* with the shared-secret header
Every tool description states the ordering rule that propose_readback precedes record_decision for anything with a dose, stated twice
Tool timeouts are set to 3 seconds or less
The system prompt contains the scope guardrail sentence verbatim
The system prompt forbids reading raw dispatch codes aloud and forbids citing an incident reference not returned by recall_memory
The system prompt specifies the tone shift from calm during the brief to clipped when confirming irreversible actions
Interruption and barge-in are enabled in the agent configuration
--print-prompt dumps the resolved system prompt

tasks.title: Tool handlers, rationale extraction, and deterministic readback composition
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/voice/index.ts default-exports an object satisfying VoicePort
composeReadback is pure deterministic string formatting with no LLM call and reproduces the dose and units exactly
Rationale extraction returns null rather than a fabricated rationale when the utterance contains no reason
Extraction on all 8 records in fixtures/utterances.json produces the expected action and rationale split
The extractor never invents a rationale, verified against the fixture cases that deliberately omit one
GET /api/voice/signed-url returns url and agentId and the ElevenLabs API key never appears in any client bundle
GET /api/voice/conversation-token returns token and agentId; the operator console uses this token, not the signed URL
npm run typecheck passes

tasks.title: Browser WebRTC operator console and live voice verification
acceptanceCriteria: app/voice/page.tsx connects a live session via useConversation and shows connection state, mic level, and the current incident
The agent speaks a brief derived from a real recall_memory call, verified by the tool invocation appearing in the server log
Speaking over the agent mid-brief stops it, verified by ear
Stating a drug and dose triggers propose_readback before any record_decision, verified by server log ordering
The spoken readback contains the dose and units exactly as said with no rounding or paraphrase
Confirming resumes the LangGraph interrupt and the graph advances
Stating an action with no reason produces exactly one short follow-up question
A decision recorded by voice appears in decisions with a non-empty rationale
The agent never speaks a raw dispatch code, verified against the transcript
Asking what should I give produces a refusal plus an attributed guideline quote, never a treatment suggestion
Time from end of medic speech to first agent audio on the brief is under about 1.5 seconds
close_call produces a postmortem and a PCR draft

tasks.title: Fixture-driven dashboard matching reference.png
acceptanceCriteria: With NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENTS_MODE=fixture and no backend running, the dashboard renders the full state shown in reference.png
The header shows incident ref 260813-0442, the expanded call type, dispatch area B3, unit 14B, an elapsed timer, and a recording pill
The layout is a two-column split at roughly 60/40 with the voice timeline left and the memory panel right
Medic and agent turns are visually distinguished and clock times render in monospace
The decision capture renders as a highlighted bordered block visually distinct from ordinary turns
A pending readback renders as an amber Awaiting readback pill
Vector search hits render with right-aligned monospace similarity scores of 0.91, 0.87, and 0.84, plus one retrieved snippet in full
Write counter tiles render decisions 7 and timeline 34
The footer renders the graph node chain with readback_gate highlighted and a checkpoint indicator reading 34
The event union is rendered with an exhaustive switch so an unhandled event kind is a compile error
Body text is at least 14px and no text a judge must read is low-contrast gray on dark
npm run build and npm run typecheck both pass

tasks.title: Live SSE wiring with replay, gap detection, and reconnect
acceptanceCriteria: In real mode the dashboard consumes GET /api/events via EventSource and bootstraps counters from GET /api/counters
The useEventStream hook applies the initial replay frame before live events
A seq gap is detected and triggers a refetch rather than being silently ignored
Killing and restarting the server causes the dashboard to reconnect with backoff and repopulate, never showing a blank screen
The timeline auto-scrolls on new entries but pauses auto-scroll when the operator has scrolled up
The checkpoint counter visibly increments as checkpoint events arrive

tasks.title: Demo scripts and automated preflight
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/demo-fire.ts fires either scenario by pattern name and prints the incident ref
scripts/demo-reset.ts restores a clean slate without touching runbooks or seeded memory
npm run preflight checks that all four vs_* indexes report READY
Preflight asserts the decisions collection is empty
Preflight asserts seeded postmortem count is at least 30 and runbook chunk count is at least 30
Preflight fails when any port is resolving to a fake, detected by grepping for FAKE PORT warnings

Preflight verifies the tunnel URL resolves and a tool route answers with the shared secret
Preflight verifies the worker is running in the expected trigger mode
Preflight exits non-zero on any failure and prints a single go or no-go line

tasks.title: Run of show, pitch notes, and rehearsed kill-and-resume
acceptanceCriteria: docs/run-of-show.md contains the three-minute beat table with all nine time codes from 0:00 to 2:40

The kill-and-resume section lists exact keystrokes and requires three rehearsals
The cut list and the never-cut list both appear in the run of show
docs/pitch-notes.md leads with the 15.0 percent figure and its 5,653,498-incident basis
docs/pitch-notes.md states that the medic never looks at a screen and that the agent never makes a clinical call
docs/preflight.md mirrors every automated check plus the manual audio and window-position items
The closing response-time delta is documented with its derivation from real dataset fields and is computed before going on stage
The kill-and-resume has been rehearsed three times end to end with the full voice path

tasks.title: Flip all ports to real and refuse to proceed on fakes or unreadiness
acceptanceCriteria: npm run integrate exits 0 against the live cluster with all *_MODE=real
npm run integrate exits non-zero if any port resolves to a fake
npm run integrate exits non-zero if any vs_* index is not READY
npm run integrate exits non-zero if decisions is not empty

Corpus floors are the demo-slice numbers from contracts.md section 14: at least 100 historical incidents, 20 UNC-ARREST, 20 SICK-CARD, 30 seeded postmortems, 2 curated, 10 failure remediations, 30 runbooks
data/pitch-numbers.json exists and is served from cache
No FAKE PORT line appears in the integrate log on a passing run

tasks.title: One smoke call through fire, readback, decision, close, and kill-resume
acceptanceCriteria: npm run smoke completes in under 90 seconds and exits 0
After smoke, decisions contains exactly one document with a non-empty rationale
After smoke, exactly one postmortem has origin live
Seeded postmortem and runbook counts are identical before and after smoke
propose_readback in the smoke path returns 1 milligram and epinephrine with no rounding
npm run drill exits 0 on the smoke incident or a dedicated drill incident
